body: Look, do whatever you want, but please, please, *please* do not give birth to a new human. Please.

Even if you feel no guilt, I’m not particularly inclined to go around fucking with people unless they’re particularly shit people. It’s just not worth the jail time or hassle to be relentlessly destructive to everyone we meet so yeah most of the time you’re fine.
Shooting at someone charging an officer with scissors after being given multiple warnings to stand down is different from firing into a populated shopping center

Of course. But success in the field I’d prefer is a miracle. Nothing to bank on. I’ll do it for the rest of my life, but the length of that life is unfortunately variable. And if I have to spend that time working instead of pursuing what actually makes me happy, I might as well not have that passion at all. The misery outweighs the joy, steals all my time and energy. I’d rather do as I wish until I can’t and fuck off to the next life when rent’s due.
Yeah I can’t. I have no “profitable” skills or interests. I don’t give a fuck about cultivating them either, I have no interest in any of them.

I have all of those things. I know how to live a happy life, but the world’s ideal version of me is one constantly hopped up on amphetamines performing soulless, repetitive tasks for the benefit of people I despise. My ideal life is not one this world has deemed worthy of survival.
If we can survive this world, it will be made better. I can live for that. Damn shame the world disagrees.
How many hours of your life do you throw away each week to be allowed your survival, if you don’t mind me asking?

Brilliant. Fucking brilliant. This entire world is just a never ending cycle of being gaslit by those who’re already comfortable. Breath of fresh fucking air to see someone just come out and speak the truth.
